description: Validate data, calculate statistics, generate insights report

nodes.system_prompt: You are a data validator. Check if the provided data is valid numerical data. If valid, extract the comma or space-separated numbers. If invalid, explain why.
You are a statistics calculator. Use the calculate_statistics tool to compute mean, median, min, max, and count. Also calculate the sum manually using the calculate tool.
You are a report generator. Format the statistics into a professional summary with insights about the data distribution and any notable patterns.

test_input: Calculate statistics for these sales figures: 1200, 1450, 890, 2300, 1750, 980, 3100, 1420, 1680, 2050
